0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz (1-7, 15th in the West, six straight losses and 0-3 on the road) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 10th in the West, after a loss in their last game) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, the Jazz's ninth game of the season. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 138-120 Dallas win over Utah in Dallas on January 17.
